questions.q: What decides the final image in a deterministic sampler?
options: The starting noise, plus the model, conditioning and step choices
A fresh random number at each step
questions.answer: The starting noise, plus the model, conditioning and step choices
questions.why: There is no randomness after the start: the sampler integrates an ODE.

questions.q: Heun at 20 steps costs about how many model calls?
questions.why: Two calls per step, except the last. The lab shows 19 calls at 10 steps and 79 at 40.

questions.q: Why does DPM++ 2M get second order at one call per step?
options: It reuses the denoised prediction from the previous step
questions.answer: It reuses the denoised prediction from the previous step
questions.why: D̄ combines D_i and D_(i−1), so no extra model call is needed.

questions.answer: Samples near a mode boundary that step error sent to the other mode
